title: Docker runner duplicates the official image entrypoint
detail: The official quantconnect/lean image already declares dotnet QuantConnect.Lean.Launcher.dll as ENTRYPOINT, while build_command appends another dotnet plus launcher path. Docker passes those tokens as launcher arguments instead of replacing the entrypoint, so the command does not follow the official launcher contract.

title: Run-local LEAN data root omits mandatory auxiliary databases and KRX equity registration
detail: The exporter creates only an equity daily zip, then the runner bind-mounts that directory over /Lean/Data. Current LEAN loads market-hours and symbol-properties databases from that root, so both markets fail on missing files; even with stock databases restored, the official market-hours database has no Equity-krx entry.

title: Daily scheduled market orders do not implement completed-T to next-open fills
detail: At the next market open the daily subscription still exposes the prior completed bar price. Current LEAN EquityFillModel waits for fresh data for stale daily bars, so the market order fills when later daily data arrives rather than at the next open; sizing also uses the stale security price.

title: OHLCV query cannot load persisted KR rows and can label adjusted rows as RAW
detail: The query binds KR, but the collection pipeline persists Korean rows as KOSPI or KOSDAQ, so valid KR runs see no rows. The query also ignores is_adjusted while the template declares RAW normalization.

title: Backtest run claiming is not atomic
detail: Two dispatches can both read PENDING. The second service update observes RUNNING and returns it as idempotent, after which both orchestrators execute the same UUID workspace. Repository update has no expected-status predicate or compare-and-set.

title: Workspace creation follows a pre-existing run-root symlink outside the artifact root
detail: root_for and data_root_for return unchecked lexical paths and export writes before workspace validation. A pre-created UUID symlink redirects zip, config, results, and logs outside artifact_root. Reader-side confinement does not protect the writer.

title: In-process executor lifecycle and background exceptions are unmanaged
detail: The module-global ThreadPoolExecutor is not owned by FastAPI lifespan and submitted Futures are discarded. Shutdown can wait on a long Docker task, process restart loses queued work, and failures before the orchestrator try block remain invisible with a run stuck PENDING.

title: Production PostgreSQL and LEAN contracts are only asserted through fakes and text scans
detail: Repository round trips feed params directly into row conversion, migration tests scan SQL text, exporter tests replace the production query adapter, and template tests replace LEAN. These tests cannot catch SQL/driver, market vocabulary, launcher, or engine fill-contract failures.

title: Daily scheduled market orders do not implement completed-T to next-open fills
detail: The adapter is unchanged: after_market_open reads the stale daily Security.Price and submits a regular market order. LEAN EquityFillModel requires post-order fresh data, so this cannot guarantee a next-open fill or exact opening-price sizing. The fake adapter test manually injects price and fills immediately, so it does not exercise that engine contract.

title: Buy MOO rejection emits the same stable audit code in both the order event and algorithm log
context: quant-worker backtest-engine Step 6 MOO spec review
detail: Step 6 acceptance requires exactly one moo_buying_power_rejected audit record. ProjectFillModel puts the code in the invalid OrderEvent message, then on_order_event logs the same code again, producing two artifact records for one rejection.

title: Required fixed-template MOO and dual-profile snapshot acceptance coverage is incomplete
context: quant-worker backtest-engine Step 6 MOO spec review
detail: The fixed-template tests cover initial MOO submission and fill-model rejection only; they do not exercise adapter-level rejection re-arm, full sell MOO, or terminal unfilled audit. Snapshot byte assertions cover KR only, not the required US profile.

title: LEAN MOO costs are based on the daily close instead of the opening fill
detail: The custom EquityFillModel delegates MOO pricing to LEAN, which fills from TradeBar.Open, but ProjectSlippageModel and ProjectFeeModel calculate from Security.Price. For a daily TradeBar, Value/Security.Price is the bar close, so open != close produces the wrong slippage amount, fee, affordability threshold, and portfolio cash versus the approved actual-open contract.

title: Fixed-template tests do not exercise required MOO adapter boundaries
detail: The fixed-template suite does not cover an open different from close, false-to-true re-arm through on_order_event, the full-position sell path, or terminal unfilled audit through on_end. Pure trace tests cover domain logic but cannot catch LEAN adapter price-model and callback integration defects.

title: Golden MOO sizing coverage does not isolate both caps or whole-share floor boundaries
context: quant-worker backtest-engine Step 6 MOO spec re-review
detail: step-6 tasks 3 and deterministic acceptance 2 require hand-calculated target_limit=4, cash_limit=4, and whole-share floor-boundary tests. The current golden test asserts gap/reference prices and only the final min quantity, so one cap can be wrong or a boundary regression can occur without this required acceptance coverage failing.

title: LEAN default buying-power precheck can reject an affordable MOO from the daily close
context: quant-worker/backtest-engine Step 6 MOO final re-review after open-cost fix
detail: The algorithm installs open-aware fee, slippage, and fill models but leaves LEAN default buying-power handling in place. BacktestingBrokerage checks buying power before invoking the fill model, and the default equity calculation uses Security.Price, which is the daily TradeBar close. When next-bar open is affordable but its close is sufficiently higher, LEAN rejects the order before ProjectFillModel can apply the approved actual-open affordability decision. The fixed-template tests call market_on_open_fill directly and therefore bypass this engine ordering.

title: Composed quant-worker cannot launch its nested LEAN Docker process
detail: The repository compose path builds quant-worker from python:3.11-slim and publishes port 8082, but the image installs no Docker CLI and compose mounts neither the Docker socket nor a host-visible workspace. Every dispatched run reaches subprocess.run([docker, run, ...]) and fails with FileNotFoundError; even adding only the socket would leave bind sources under /app/runs invisible to the host daemon.

title: Adjusted collection overwrites the raw rows required by backtests
detail: The backtest query now correctly requires is_adjusted = FALSE, but market_daily_ohlcv is unique only on source,symbol,trade_date and the collector upsert overwrites is_adjusted and OHLC values. Collecting the same day with auto_adjust/adjusted=true replaces the raw row; a later backtest omits that day (or the whole range), silently changing indicators and results for partially overwritten ranges.

title: Signal evaluation recomputes full factor history on every bar
detail: For every incoming bar and every factor, StrategySignalEvaluator rebuilds the complete source_values list and calls evaluate_factor_series over the complete history merely to read series[-1]. Across N bars this is at least O(F*N^2); SMA/WMA additionally rescan window slices, making ordinary multi-year daily runs capable of exhausting the 600-second execution budget.

title: Compose restarts discard result and log artifacts for completed runs
detail: BACKTEST_ARTIFACT_ROOT defaults to relative runs, while the quant-worker compose service has no volume for /app/runs. PostgreSQL retains COMPLETED metadata and artifact_path across a container recreation, but the result JSON and logs disappear, so /result and /logs become permanently unavailable after an ordinary restart.

title: Runner timeout kills only the Docker client and can leave the LEAN container running
detail: subprocess.run timeout terminates the local docker CLI process. The command assigns no container name/cidfile and performs no daemon-side stop/kill, while --rm removes a container only after that container exits. A hung LEAN process can therefore continue consuming host resources after the run is marked FAILED and after a worker slot is released.

title: 디자인 시스템 부분 적용을 전체 적용으로 오인할 위험으로 사용자 확인이 반복됨
detail: 초기 적용 범위가 전체 라우트인지 결정적으로 감사되지 않아 사용자가 적용 여부와 전체 화면 전환을 반복 확인했다. 이후 production TSX 전수 계약 테스트와 11개 라우트 감사로 범위를 증명했다.

title: 모바일 사이드바의 숨김 상태가 키보드·접근성 트리에서 비활성화되지 않음
detail: opacity/pointer-events/transform만 전환해 닫힌 drawer의 버튼과 링크가 계속 탐색되고, 열린 상태도 배경 inert·포커스 트랩/복귀가 없다. review C-01.

title: 라우트 오류 경계가 경로 변경 후에도 실패 상태를 영구 유지함
detail: hasError가 location/children 변경으로 초기화되지 않고 전체 Routes 바깥을 감싸 한 라우트 오류 후 정상 라우트로 이동해도 reload 전까지 fallback이 남는다. review C-02.

title: 공용 웹 셸에 토큰 없는 임의 px·타이포 값을 직접 추가함
detail: max-w-[1600px], backdrop-blur-[2px], text-[11px], 임의 tracking 값이 frontend 디자인 토큰 규약을 위반한다. Sidebar/PageHeader/TopBar 포함. review C-03.

title: 닫힌 모바일 사이드바의 컨트롤이 키보드 포커스 순서에 남는다
detail: feature-spec EDGE-06은 메뉴에 보이는 focus를 요구한다. Sidebar.tsx:26-96은 닫힘 시 opacity/pointer-events/transform만 적용해 backdrop button, close button, 11개 NavLink를 focus tree에서 제거하지 않는다.

title: 명시된 App route·unknown URL 통합 테스트가 없다
detail: feature-spec §10과 development-plan §6은 App route 및 route 오류·unknown URL integration을 요구한다. 현재 테스트는 standalone boundary의 동기 throw와 injected callback만 검증하고 App/Routes, replace redirect, lazy rejection, 기본 reload retry는 실행하지 않는다.

title: 필수 desktop/mobile 시각 검증 증거가 없다
detail: feature-spec §10 및 development-plan §6의 브라우저 screenshot 비교가 browser 연결 부재로 미실행이다. overflow, focus visibility, heading 간격, responsive layout은 미확인이며 제품 결함 단정이 아니라 완료 기준 증거 누락이다.

title: 열린 모바일 사이드바를 데스크톱으로 넓히면 본문 inert가 고착됨
detail: Sidebar effect가 isOpen만 의존해 모바일 open 상태에서 viewport만 데스크톱으로 바뀌면 cleanup이 실행되지 않는다. App resize는 true를 true로 설정해 재렌더하지 않고 main이 inert로 남는다. CSS lg와 JS >1024 기준도 정확히 1024px에서 불일치한다. review C-04.

title: 신규 라우트 오류 화면에 토큰 없는 45vh 높이를 직접 추가함
detail: 공용 RouteErrorPage가 min-h-[45vh] arbitrary 값을 사용해 frontend 디자인 토큰 규약을 위반한다. review C-05.

title: drawer 키보드 처리가 desktop sidebar를 inert 또는 focus trap 상태로 만든다
detail: feature-spec EDGE-06/RULE-06 위반. Sidebar.tsx:40-65의 Tab/Escape handler에 mobile viewport guard가 없고 89-90의 aria-hidden/inert는 isOpen만 따른다. Desktop에서 Tab이 lg:hidden close button으로 가로채지거나 Escape 후 보이는 sidebar가 inert가 되며, App.tsx:51의 >1024 분기와 Tailwind lg 경계가 달라 정확히 1024px에서도 sidebar가 visible+inert다.
